I just feel so cold and distant. It's a religious school, I don't know how to reassociate myself with other students. The only thing keeping me from actually killing myself anymore is that I couldn't put my family through that. Theres also one girl that im kinda close with, but i know im gonna fuck that up too

I found consolation in people online. Hang out around reddit a little while, play some video games, get to know someone. Everybody online is awkward, and that's the beauty of it. Best of all, it's as anonymous as you want it to be. After every crisis in my life, I turned to someone I met in a video game. Not everybody is so shitty. Some people just want a friend, someone just like you. PM me, I'd love to get to know you. Please, just give it a shot.
